qty.description:
Number of contracts. Required for both single-leg and
 multi-leg orders. For multi-leg, this is the strategy
 multiplier — each leg's ratio_qty is scaled by this
 value (e.g., qty="10" with ratio_qty="2" = 20
 contracts for that leg).

time_in_force.description:
"day" only. Options do not support other
           values.

symbol.description:
OCC option symbol (e.g., "AAPL250321C00150000").
    Required for single-leg.

position_intent.description:
"buy_to_open", "buy_to_close", "sell_to_open",
             or "sell_to_close". Clarifies whether the trade
             opens or closes a position. Optional but
             recommended.

limit_price.description:
Required for limit orders. For multi-leg, this is
         the net debit/credit (positive = debit/cost,
         negative = credit/proceeds).

client_order_id.description:
Unique idempotency key. If the request times out,
             you can safely retry with the same value — the API
             will reject duplicates. Recommended for every order.

order_class.description:
Set to "mleg" for multi-leg orders. Automatically
         inferred when legs are provided.

legs.description:
List of leg dicts for multi-leg orders (max 4). Each leg
  requires "symbol" and "ratio_qty" (string). Optional
  per-leg fields: "side" ("buy" or "sell") and
  "position_intent".
